posture-rollup.summary: mitigation-to-technique map AND the mitigation implementation store in one file

entries.reason: implService.summarize() gives mitigations by status; the mitigation ranking by group reach is mitigation-level. Known numbers read PostureService.rollup since P2-08. Removed by E9.3 (plan:892); the ranking goes to E7.2 (plan:862).

Implementation-counts tile counts mitigations by status; the status map is passed through to the HTML report and XLSX export; mitigationsByTechnique feeds two Known lookups (average mitigations per technique, technique of the day). None counts techniques as implemented; Known numbers read PostureService.rollup since P2-08. Dashboard tiles fold into Home (plan:466,813).
Status fold techniqueImplStatus and impl= (P2-14, implViewFor) and the bulk-set reverse rollup (P2-16). Stays listed after P2-16 with reason mitigation-level or export only (Addendum note 3).
entries.removedBy: P2-14, P2-16 (stays listed for mitigation-level uses)

entries.reason: Ranks mitigations to do next from the status map and techniquesByMitigation; mitigation-level; E7.2.

implService.summarize() gives mitigations by status; the recommended-mitigations list ranks not-yet-implemented mitigations through statusMap and techniquesByMitigation. Both mitigation-level; the split and the CSV Implemented column moved in P2-07. Report-panel becomes the ReportService UI (plan:447).

setStatus writes mitigation status by design; the roadmap and auto-roadmap score mitigations through getTechniquesForMitigation, techniquesByMitigation and the status map, including the per-mitigation uncovered count (any mapped mitigation implemented; Addendum note 4). Known numbers read PostureService.rollup since P2-08. E5.5 is the single which-mitigation-next ranker (plan:456).
Scenario outcomes use the legacy implemented fold (getStatusMap over mitigationsByTechnique); P2-12 gives them PostureService numerators (bounded window, design 4.1).
Implementation data block: import, export and reset of the mitigation status map; mitigation-level exports by design.

Sidebar mitigation rows set mitigation status (P2-16: technique marks, qualifier badge and Confirm). Its other mitigation lists are display-only: lists mitigations, does not count techniques (Addendum note 3).
Filters exported rules by implemented mitigation; does not count techniques; E6.2.

implStats counts the distinct mitigations of a tactic by status (mitigationsByTechnique plus status$). Mitigation-level; the Known count and the posture lines read PostureService.rollup since P2-08. Becomes TacticRollup on PostureService in E9.3 (plan:467,892).
Mitigation targets by reach; mitigation-level; E7.2.
Hypothetical projections: what marking a mitigation implemented would change. Not a statement of current posture; E7.2.
Filters exported rules by implemented mitigation; does not count techniques; E6.2.
The pure D16 breadth-guard rollup (P2-01) the adapters call: an implemented mitigation marks its techniques, full or partial. Part of the seam; 100% branch-gated in CI.

getControlStatus is a control-level aggregate of mitigation statuses (controls implemented (attested), plan:157,371): mitigation-level by design, not a technique count. E6.7 (Rate your posture, plan:849) revisits it.
Passes the status map to the CSV, XLSX, PNG and report exporters; mitigation-level exports by design.
The impl= mitigation-status filter: matches only through the ImplStatus type and a techniquesByMitigation lookup for the mitigation filter; it counts nothing.

Mitigation status table: each mitigation with its mapped parent count, from the status map passed in. Mitigation-level, counts no technique as implemented; the technique badge and the split moved to PostureService in P2-07. E9.1 retires html-report.service (plan:890).
PNG export; its heat=status colour uses the best-status fold over mitigationsByTechnique, which P2-14 routes through implViewFor or lists as a bounded export window (Addendum note 4). E9.1.

The foreign-comment import writes every mitigation of a technique (a reverse rollup); P2-16 moves it to technique marks. The export fold and import parsing stay listed with reason mitigation-level or export only (Addendum notes 3 and 4).
entries.removedBy: P2-16 (stays listed for export and import parsing)

entries.reason: PostureService store adapters (P2-05): implementationAdapter and implView turn mitigation statuses into Covered marks over techniquesByMitigation with the D16 breadth guard. Part of the seam.

PostureService: the one place the mitigation status store and the mitigation-to-technique map are joined into one PostureState per technique (P2-05). Every other surface reads it; this file is what the rule protects.
Threat simulation uses the legacy implemented fold; P2-12 gives it PostureService numerators (bounded window, design 4.1).

XLSX export: Known mitigation-only sheets plus the Impl Status (best) column, a per-technique best-status fold that P2-14 routes through implViewFor or lists as a bounded export window (Addendum note 4). E9.1.
